parts.text: {"title": "Guide", "sections": [{"heading": "Onboarding guide", "text": "New members receive a laptop on the first day. Accounts are created by the platform team within two business days. Every new member pairs with a buddy for the first week. The buddy books the introduction meetings with each hub", "sources": ["doc-onboarding"]}, {"heading": "Release process", "text": "Releases ship every two weeks on a Wednesday. A release freeze starts on the Monday before the release. Each release needs sign-off from the test lead and the release manager. Sign-off is recorded in the release hub before the freeze", "sources": ["doc-release"]}, {"heading": "Board export", "text": "The export writes every visible column of the board to a CSV file. Hidden columns are never exported. An export covers at most five thousand rows. Larger boards are exported in pages named by their page number. Only members with", "sources": ["doc-export"]}, {"heading": "Billing gateway", "text": "Billing moves to the new gateway on the first of November. The old gateway stays in read-only mode for ninety days. A failed charge is retried three times, one hour apart. After the third failure the invoice is marked as", "sources": ["doc-billing"]}, {"heading": "Search cluster", "text": "The search index is rebuilt every night at two in the morning. A rebuild takes about forty minutes for the largest organisation. Archived items stay out of the default search results. A filter shows archived items when asked.", "sources": ["doc-search"]}], "empty_reason": null, "rationale": "One section per source, in the sources' own words."}
